parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the toaster's front panel, typically used to control specific functions such as canceling the toasting process.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to stop the toasting cycle or activate a specific mode by pressing it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A plastic slider lever on the toaster's front used to lower and raise the bread carriage.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal mechanism to start the toasting process when pushed down.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward to engage the heating cycle and springs back up when the toast is done.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: Another slider component, possibly for adjusting browning level or timing, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It adjusts the toasting duration or heat intensity by sliding horizontally or vertically.
parts.Movement_description: It moves smoothly along a guided track to set the desired toasting level.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster made of stainless steel, housing all internal components and providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the heating elements, electrical circuits, and mechanical parts, ensuring safety and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a rigid frame for the other moving parts.
